# BlockSec

> > BlockSec provides institutional-grade Web3 security software including Phalcon Explorer, MetaSleuth fund tracking, and blockchain compliance solutions for Ethereum, Solana, and EVM-compatible chains.

BlockSec specializes in smart contract security, threat detection, transaction monitoring, and DeFi risk mitigation. The platform offers tools for analyzing blockchain transactions, tracking illicit fund flows, and securing decentralized applications across multiple chains including Ethereum, Solana, Monad, and Plasma.

## Key Topics

- Web3 Security
- Smart Contract Security
- Blockchain Compliance
- Phalcon Explorer
- MetaSleuth Fund Tracking
- Transaction Monitoring
- DeFi Risk Management
- EVM Security

- AI Trading Security
- ERC20 Token Security
- Crypto Payment Compliance
